admin.label: Operations
admin.description: Manage the occasions your organisation works at.

permissions.manageDescription: Create and edit operations, move them through their statuses and delete them.
permissions.readDescription: Read the public operations and the ones you take part in.

admin.title: Operations
admin.listDescription: The occasions your organisation works at, whether or not it hosts them.
admin.createDescription: It starts in planning. Move it along when the plans are final.
admin.operationLoadFailed: The operation could not be loaded
admin.forbidden: You do not have access to operations
admin.emptyDescription: Add the first operation, such as a festival bar, to attach crew and shifts to it.
admin.name: Name
admin.descriptionHelp: Shown on the public page. Markdown is supported.
admin.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
admin.endsBeforeStart: The end cannot be before the start.
admin.hostNameHelp: Who hosts it: your organisation, or the venue or event you work at.
admin.hostUrlInvalid: Enter a web address starting with https://.
admin.eventIdHelp: The id of the event this operation belongs to.
admin.publicHelp: A public operation has a public page and shows for everyone. Others show to the people who take part.
admin.archiveDescription: An archived operation is final: it cannot be started or reopened.
admin.deleteDescription: Its venue layout is deleted with it; crew and shifts attached to it stay behind without an operation. Archive an operation that has been worked instead.
admin.locationMapHelp: Tap the map to place the operation, and give it a radius or draw its area.
admin.venueLayoutHelp: Where the stations, containers and areas are. Shifts point to them, and the live layers draw on them.
admin.venueLoadFailed: The venue layout could not be loaded.
admin.venueLiveHelp: The saved layout as crew see it, with the live layers.
